title: 'No ambiguity': Pak says Mecca pact applies as Saudi Arabia faces Houthi threat
summary_full: Pakistan reiterated its commitment to a defense pact with Saudi Arabia and Turkiye.  This agreement mandates collective deterrence against any armed attack on members.  Saudi Arabia reported intercepting a Houthi drone near Mecca, which the Houthis denied.  Pakistan emphasized its duty to protect Muslim holy sites, even without a formal pact.  The nation also urged diplomacy to prevent wider regional conflict escalation.
